title: KY PSC Order — Case No. 2020-00340: ELECTRONIC HYDEN-LESLIE WATER DISTRICT’S UNACCOUNTED-FOR WATER LOSS REDUCTION PLAN, SURCHARGE AND MONITORING
text:
COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY 

BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 

In the Matter of: 

ELECTRONIC HYDEN-LESLIE WATER 
DISTRICT’S UNACCOUNTED-FOR WATER LOSS 
REDUCTION PLAN, SURCHARGE AND 
MONITORING 
) 
) 
) 
) 

CASE NO. 
2020-00340 
O R D E R 
On February 25, 2026, Hyden-Leslie Water District (Hyden-Leslie District) filed a 
notice of exhaustion of surcharge proceeds and motion to close and remove proceedings 
from active docket and for relief from reporting requirements (Motion) in both this matter 
as well as Case No. 2020-00141.1 
BACKGROUND 
The Commission initiated this case on November 6, 2020, to monitor Hyden-Leslie 
District’s water loss surcharge granted in Case No. 2020-00141,2 and the progress of its 
water loss reduction efforts. The November 6, 2020 Order in Case No. 2020-00141 
established that Hyden-Leslie District was to collect a monthly water loss surcharge of 
$1.53 per meter for 48 months or until $263,124 had been assessed, which ever occurred 
first.3 The November 6, 2020 Order established several reporting requirements, including 
the submission of a comprehensive unaccounted-for water loss reduction plan, monthly

water loss reports, and a monthly activity report that included “a statement of monthly 
surcharge billings and collections; a monthly surcharge bank statement; a list of each 
payment from the account, its payee, and a description of the purpose; and invoices 
supporting each payment.”4 The November 6, 2020 Order further required that Hyden-
Leslie District seek prior approval from the Commission prior to spending any funds from 
the water surcharge account.5 On the same date, the Commission established Case No. 
2020-00340 to monitor the assessment, collection and expenditure of surcharge funds. 
In its Order establishing this proceeding, the Commission ordered the same reporting 
requirements as had been set forth in the Order in Case No. 2020-00141.6 
DISCUSSION 

In its Motion, Hyden-Leslie District stated it has timely complied with all reporting 
requirements set forth in the November 6, 2020 Orders in both proceedings, with Hyden-
Leslie District’s most recent monthly activity report filed on February 13, 2026.7 Hyden-
Leslie further stated it advised the Commission on November 7, 2024, that, pursuant to 
the terms of the November 6, 2020 Order, Hyden-Leslie District discontinued collection 
of the surcharge beginning on bills issued in December 2024 as the authorized period for 
collection of the surcharge had run.8

-3- 
Case No. 2020-00340 
By Order issued January 30, 2025, the Commission authorized Hyden-Leslie 
District to expend the full balance of its surcharge account funds for the purchase of a 
portable flow meter and 764 meters and related meter accessories and services.9 
In its Motion, Hyden-Leslie asserted that it advised the Commission in its monthly 
activity report filed January 14, 2026, that the authorized expenditures had been made, 
and all funds in the surcharge account had been exhausted.10 Hyden-Leslie argued in its 
Motion, that, with the surcharge having ended and all surcharge proceeds having been 
expended for authorized purposes, no reason exists for this proceeding to remain on the 
Commission’s active docket.11 Hyden-Leslie District accordingly requested that the 
Commission close this proceeding and remove it from the Commission’s active docket 
and relieve Hyden-Leslie District of further compliance with the reporting requirements 
set forth in the November 6, 2020 Orders.12 
The Commission finds that Hyden-Leslie’s Motion should be granted. Hyden-
Leslie District has met its reporting requirements, has now fully exhausted the surcharge 
funds towards Commission approved expenditures, and should be released from the 
reporting requirements that were established in Case No. 2020-00141 and ordered as 
part of the monitoring requirements in Case No. 2020-00340. Case No. 2020-00141 was 
previously closed and removed from the docket on November 6, 2020.13 The

Commission further finds that Case No. 2020-00340 should be closed and removed from 
the docket. 

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED that: 
1. 
Hyden-Leslie District’s Motion is granted. Hyden-Leslie District is released 
from the reporting requirements established by Orders issued November 6, 2020, in both 
Case No. 2020-00141 and Case No. 2020-00340. 
2. 
Case No. 2020-00340 is hereby closed and removed from the docket. 
3. 
A copy of this Order shall be filed in the post-case file for Case No. 2020-
00141.
